title: 第1116章 破境之锋第1115章 青木论道
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
第1116章破境之锋
回到青木岭后的第三天，云昊在仙泉边盘膝而坐。
晨光还未完全穿透紫竹林的枝叶，露珠在竹叶上凝成细密的水珠，整个山谷笼罩在一片朦胧的薄雾中。
云昊闭着眼，混元仙力在经脉中缓缓流淌，那种流动的感觉与之前截然不同。
不再是试探性的推进，而是一种自然而然的奔涌，如同春水融冰后的第一场洪流。
他感觉到丹田中那缕微光点开始膨胀，从针尖大小逐渐变大，像一颗种子在土壤中吸足了水分，开始缓慢而坚定地撑开外壳。
付荣靠在紫竹林边缘的竹子上，他没有出声。
能感知到云昊周身的气息在变化，混元仙力的波动频率在加快，从平缓的潮汐变成了持续的脉动。
那种波动他太熟悉了，他自己经历过两次，每一次都让全身经脉如被烈火灼烧。
没有打扰，只是安静地等候，如同一块立在竹林边缘的黑色岩石。
青木翁拄着木杖站在古木下，琥珀色的眼睛望着山谷方向，手中的木杖轻轻点着地面，发出细微的笃笃声，像是在为云昊数着时辰。
云昊的识海中，那扇门在缓缓打开。
金光从门缝中透出，不刺目，却厚重。
看见门后的天地，看见混元仙力在新的层次中运转的轨迹，如同一张精密的地图在眼前展开。
知道自己不能急，不能强行推开那扇门，只能让它自己打开。
一个时辰后，他感觉到丹田中的微光点停止膨胀，不再扩大，不再缩小，只是稳定在一个新的状态。
比之前更加明亮，更加凝练，如同一颗被重新锻造过的宝石。
一缕新的混元仙力从丹田中心涌出，沿着七条主脉同时扩散。
这一次的混元仙力比之前更加流畅，更加浑厚，在经脉壁中留下的那层九色光泽也更加稳定。
睁开眼，掌心中浮现出一团光芒。

那团光芒比之前任何一次都要凝实，如同一颗实心的光球，内部流转着九色灵光、淡金色的建木之力、黑色的魔元，交织在一起，形成一种沉稳而深邃的光泽。
他的混元仙力，终于踏入了第三重。
付荣睁开眼，走进山谷，低头看着他掌心中那团光芒，看了片刻：“第三重。比我想象的快。”
他的语气平淡，但云昊能感觉到他话语中那种细微的认可。
青木翁从古木下走出来，拄着木杖远远看了一眼，没有说话，只是点了点头，转身走回古木下。
墨羽从阴影中走出来，站在紫竹林边缘。
雷虎从洞府门口探出头来。所有人都感知到了那股气息的变化。
混元三重的波动在青木岭的空气中散开，如同石子投入水中激起的涟漪。
云昊收起那团光芒，站起身，活动了一下筋骨，骨节发出清脆的响声，混元仙力在七条主脉中奔涌，比之前更加浑厚。
当天下午，雷虎在紫竹林外的空地上等他。
雷虎已经听付荣说了云昊突破混元三重的消息，他早就想和云昊再打一场了。
站在空地中央，拳头上流转着赤红色的光芒，浑身肌肉绷紧，如同一座即将喷发的火山：“大哥，俺听说你三重了。让俺试试。”
云昊没有拒绝，走到空地中央，在雷虎对面站定。
两人没有多余的对话，雷虎率先动了。
一拳轰出，赤红色的光芒撕裂空气，如同流星坠落，拳风将地面的落叶卷起，在空中碎成粉末。
云昊没有躲，抬起右手，掌心中凝聚出那团稳定的混元仙力，与雷虎的拳头碰撞在一起。
一声闷响，气浪向四周扩散，将紫竹林的竹子压得弯下了腰，竹叶簌簌飘落。
雷虎后退了八步，拳头微微发麻，低头看着自己的拳头，又抬头看了看云昊：“大哥，你这第三重比俺想的厉害。”
云昊说：“你的拳法也比以前快了。”
雷虎咧嘴笑，再次冲了上去。

一拳接一拳，如同暴雨倾盆，赤红色的拳影在空气中留下一道道残影。

Chapter 1116: The Edge of Breaking the Realm
On the third day after returning to Qingmuling, Yunhao sat cross-legged by the fairy spring.
The morning light has not completely penetrated the branches and leaves of the purple bamboo forest. The dewdrops condensed into fine water droplets on the bamboo leaves, and the entire valley was shrouded in a hazy mist.
Yun Hao closed his eyes, Hunyuan Immortal Power slowly flowed through his meridians, and the feeling of flow was completely different from before.
It is no longer a tentative push, but a natural surge, like the first torrent after the spring water melts.
He felt that the shimmering spot in his dantian began to expand, gradually increasing from the size of a needle tip, like a seed that had absorbed enough water in the soil and began to slowly but firmly open its outer shell.
Fu Rong leaned on the bamboo at the edge of the purple bamboo forest and said nothing.
He could feel that the aura around Yun Hao was changing, and the fluctuation frequency of Hunyuan Immortal Power was accelerating, from a gentle tide to a continuous pulsation.
He was too familiar with that kind of fluctuation. He had experienced it twice himself, and each time the meridians in his body felt like they were being burned by fire.
No interruption, just waiting quietly, like a black rock standing on the edge of the bamboo forest.
Qingmu Weng stood under the ancient tree with a wooden staff, his amber eyes looking towards the valley, the wooden staff in his hand gently tapped the ground, making a subtle clicking sound, as if he was counting the hours for Yun Hao.
In Yun Hao's sea of ​​consciousness, the door was slowly opening.
Golden light shines through the crack in the door, not dazzling, but thick.
Seeing the world behind the door, seeing the trajectory of the Hunyuan Immortal Power operating at a new level, it is like a precise map unfolding before your eyes.
I know I can't rush, I can't force the door open, I can only let it open by itself.
An hour later, he felt that the shimmering spots in his dantian stopped expanding, no longer expanding, no longer shrinking, but just stabilizing in a new state.
Brighter and more condensed than before, like a reforged gem.
A new ray of Hunyuan Immortal Power gushes out from the center of Dantian and spreads along the seven main veins at the same time.
This time, the Hunyuan Immortal Power is smoother and thicker than before, and the nine-color luster left on the meridian walls is also more stable.
Opening his eyes, a ball of light appeared in his palm.
That ball of light was more solid than ever before, like a solid ball of light, with nine colors of spiritual light, pale golden wood-building power, and black demonic energy flowing inside, intertwined together to form a steady and deep luster.
His Hunyuan Immortal Power finally entered the third level.
Fu Rong opened his eyes, walked into the valley, looked down at the ball of light in his palm, and looked at it for a moment: "The third level. Faster than I thought."
His tone was calm, but Yunhao could feel the subtle recognition in his words.
Qing Muweng walked out from under the ancient tree, looked at it from a distance with his wooden stick, said nothing, just nodded, turned around and walked back to the ancient tree.
Mo Yu walked out of the shadows and stood at the edge of the purple bamboo forest.
Lei Hu poked his head out from the door of the cave. Everyone felt the change in that aura.
The fluctuations of the third level of Hunyuan spread out in the air of Qingmuling, just like the ripples caused by pebbles thrown into water.
Yun Hao put away the ball of light, stood up, and moved his muscles and bones. The joints made a crisp sound, and the Hunyuan Immortal Power surged through the seven main veins, becoming stronger than before.
That afternoon, Lei Hu was waiting for him in the open space outside the Zizhu Forest.
Lei Hu had already heard from Fu Rong the news that Yun Hao had broken through to the third level of Hunyuan. He had long wanted to fight Yun Hao again.
Standing in the middle of the open space, red light was flowing on his fists, and his muscles were tense, like a volcano about to erupt: "Brother, I heard that you are triple-leveled. Let me try."
Yunhao did not refuse, walked to the center of the open space and stood opposite Lei Hu.
There was no unnecessary dialogue between the two, and Lei Hu took the lead.
With a punch, the crimson light tore through the air, like a falling meteor. The wind of the fist picked up the fallen leaves on the ground and shattered them into powder in the air.
Yunhao did not hide;Raising his right hand, the stable Hunyuan Immortal Power condensed in his palm and collided with Lei Hu's fist.
There was a muffled sound, and the air waves spread around, pressing the bamboos in the purple bamboo forest to bend down, and the bamboo leaves rustled down.
Lei Hu took eight steps back, his fists numb slightly. He looked down at his fists, then looked up at Yun Hao: "Brother, your third level is stronger than I thought."
Yun Hao said: "Your boxing skills are also faster than before."
Lei Hu grinned and rushed forward again.
Punch after punch, like a torrential downpour, the red fist shadows left a trail of afterimages in the air.
